research.title: Small-Object Detection Under Image Degradation
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing existing object detectors under motion blur and downsampling, with evaluation stratified by object size.
Analyzed precision and recall across degradation conditions, inspecting missed detections to distinguish localization errors from confidence threshold effects.

research.title: Illumination Sensitivity in Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Designed experiments evaluating segmentation models under brightness and contrast shifts while holding training partitions and preprocessing settings fixed.
Compared classwise overlap and boundary errors, examining whether photometric augmentation changed sensitivity to illumination shifts across scene categories.

research.title: Confidence Calibration Under Visual Corruption
bullets: Designed experiments comparing temperature scaling and uncalibrated image classifiers across corruption types, using separate validation data for calibration fitting.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, calibration error, and selective prediction curves to characterize relationships between corruption severity, confidence, and classification errors.

publications.title: Confidence Under Corruption: Evaluating Temperature Scaling and Selective Prediction in Image Classification

work.title: Image Ingestion and Validation Utilities
bullets: Implemented assigned image ingestion utilities that checked file readability, normalized metadata fields, and routed invalid uploads for review.
Added regression tests for malformed image inputs and corrected preprocessing defects identified through issue reports and code review.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Optical Flow Methods
bullets: Implemented Lucas–Kanade and Horn–Schunck optical flow methods, applying consistent grayscale preprocessing and parameter selection procedures across image pairs.
Compared endpoint errors and inspected flow fields around motion boundaries, textureless regions, and occlusions to characterize method limitations.

projects.title: Visual Retrieval with Color and Learned Features
bullets: Implemented image retrieval pipelines using color histograms and pretrained convolutional features, with consistent feature normalization and similarity scoring.
Compared retrieval precision across query categories and inspected ranking errors associated with background clutter, viewpoint changes, and color similarity.
